headline: Gannon win at Seton Hill and stretch their lead
dek: Gannon won at Seton Hill, the side nearest them in the table, in their first match since Slippery Rock beat them on their own ground. Seton Hill had held them level when the two met at Gannon. Gannon have now won eleven, drawn three and lost two.
displaced_by: Gannon won at Seton Hill, so the dek's count of ten wins is no longer true and the Slippery Rock defeat is no longer their latest result
